answer: Per-action metered burn resists sybils: every influence-bearing action — a vote, a grade, an attestation — burns a fixed non-refundable fee, so swaying an outcome costs in proportion to actions taken, not identities held. A farm needs many heads each acting to move a result, and every action burns independently: a tide of a thousand fake votes burns a thousandfold, no bulk discount, each echo a separate cost. Influence tracks the pulse of burned fees, so extra identities add only overhead. Precondition: fees burn per action regardless of identity.
